profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm an experienced full stack developer with a concentration in front-end technologies

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
As a technical consultant, I delivered high-impact solutions for diverse global clients, specializing in modernizing legacy systems and building high-performance platforms from the ground up.

- Full-Stack Development: Drove end-to-end development, mastering both modern front-end stacks (React, Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS) and robust back-end ecosystems (.NET 8/C#, Java/Scala, Node.js).

- Architectural Contribution: Actively participated in system design and re-architecture efforts, guiding modernization initiatives from legacy systems to performant stacks (e.g., to .NET 8).

- Platform Engineering & Automation: Established foundational AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines for new platforms leveraging Terraform/OpenTofu, Github Actions and Gitlab CI/CD.

- Ensured software quality and stability by practicing Test-Driven Development (TDD) with unit testing and implementing comprehensive End-to-End (E2E) test suites with Playwright and Cypress.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · JavaScript · Front-End Development · .NET Framework · C# · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SASS · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Lead Front-End Developer
positions.description:
- Led full-stack development and release of core product applications and static sites, ensuring unified execution through close collaboration with Product, Data Science, and Marketing teams.

- Mentored and led a team of three engineers, conducting daily code reviews and maintaining active feature contribution to consistently meet a weekly product release schedule.

- Architected the front-end infrastructure (React, TanStack Query, Redux) within a monorepo structure, establishing a centralized Storybook component library to accelerate development and enforce code quality standards.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Engineer working in client based full-stack projects and native mobile apps.

- Architected a Node.js WebSocket server to act as the key messaging and data layer, orchestrating the concurrent, real-time synchronization of 45+ hardware devices (HoloLens, touchscreens) for a seamless, location-based AR guest experience that was going to premiere at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

- Key contributor on the team that executed the complete architectural rebuild and redesign of the AccuWeather application, implemented in Kotlin.

- Built a AA accessibility-compliant component library using Vue.js for The Vanguard Group
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end · Kotlin · Android Development · Node.js · Vue.js · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
- Delivered full-stack development and front-end solutions for multiple pharmaceutical clients, ensuring all data handling and application architecture adhered strictly to HIPAA compliance standards.

- Developed specialized, cross-platform applications (e.g., using Electron or native iOS) designed for interactive use at medical conferences and internal client events.

- Spearheaded development across the entire stack, translating complex regulatory and data requirements into robust, high-performance web applications.
positions.insights: Skills: React · Front-end · .NET Framework · PHP · WordPress · MySQL
